detailed_descriptions.en: Lucid Cats is an online co-op horror game for up to four players featuring creepy monsters, liminal procedurally generated dream levels, and proximity voice chat. 🐾 Play with friends: Lucid Cats uses invite-only lobbies. Host a game and invite up to three friends through Steam. There is currently no public matchmaking. Solo play is also supported. FALL ASLEEP Wake together in a shared dream: weird, nostalgic, and full of valuables to take. LOOT THE DREAM Valuables are instantly credited to you. However, you can only keep them if you find the dream exit and meet the quota. PROCEDURAL LEVELS + SECURITY CAMERAS A weirdcore, dreamcore descent into places that are nostalgic, unsettling, and laid out differently every time. LAPTOP UPGRADES Security cameras, valuable trackers, and more: your Laptop is your best friend for navigating the dream world and succeeding with your friends. FIND THE EXIT Use proximity voice chat to guide each other and stay immersed. Find the exit to keep your haul. If you die in the dream, you wake with nothing.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Lucid Cats is an online co-op horror game for up to four players featuring creepy monsters, liminal procedurally generated dream levels, and proximity voice chat.

🐾 Play with friends: Lucid Cats uses invite-only lobbies. Host a game and invite up to three friends through Steam. There is currently no public matchmaking. Solo play is also supported.

  • FALL ASLEEP

    Wake together in a shared dream: weird, nostalgic, and full of valuables to take.

  • LOOT THE DREAM

    Valuables are instantly credited to you. However, you can only keep them if you find the dream exit and meet the quota.

  • PROCEDURAL LEVELS + SECURITY CAMERAS

    A weirdcore, dreamcore descent into places that are nostalgic, unsettling, and laid out differently every time.

  • LAPTOP UPGRADES

    Security cameras, valuable trackers, and more: your Laptop is your best friend for navigating the dream world and succeeding with your friends.

  • FIND THE EXIT

    Use proximity voice chat to guide each other and stay immersed. Find the exit to keep your haul. If you die in the dream, you wake with nothing.
